I now have a complete picture. Here's my diagnosis:

---

## Build Performance Diagnosis

**Project:** 1 source file (`DataService.cs`) — build takes ~700ms

### Root Cause: Analyzer Overload

The Csc (compilation) task takes **94ms** — nearly all of which is analyzer overhead for a single file. You have **5 overlapping analyzer packages**:

| Analyzer | Source |
|----------|--------|
| `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers` 8.0.0 | GlobalPackageReference (Directory.Build.props) |
| `StyleCop.Analyzers` 1.1.118 | GlobalPackageReference (Directory.Build.props) |
| `Roslynator.Analyzers` 4.7.0 | PackageReference (csproj) |
| `SonarAnalyzer.CSharp` 9.16.0.82469 | PackageReference (csproj) |
| `Meziantou.Analyzer` 2.0.127 | PackageReference (csproj) |

Plus **`EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true`** which runs IDE style rules during build too.

### Compounding Factors

1. **`TreatWarningsAsErrors=true`** + aggressive analyzers = broken builds on every style nit (22 errors currently)
2. **`GenerateDocumentationFile=true`** — adds XML doc generation overhead
3. **Significant rule overlap** — NetAnalyzers, Roslynator, SonarAnalyzer, and Meziantou all check similar things (e.g., CA1305 and MA0011 both flag the same line)

---

## Recommended Fixes (by impact)

**1. Consolidate analyzers — pick at most 2:**
```xml
<!-- Remove overlapping analyzers from .csproj -->
<PackageReference Include="Roslynator.Analyzers" Version="4.7.0" />        <!-- REMOVE -->
<PackageReference Include="SonarAnalyzer.CSharp" Version="9.16.0.82469" /> <!-- REMOVE -->
```
Keep NetAnalyzers (built-in, lightweight) + one of Meziantou or StyleCop — not both.

**2. Move analyzers to editor-only (don't run during build):**
```xml
<!-- In Directory.Build.props -->
<EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>false</EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>
```
This makes IDE rules run only in the editor/CI with `-p:EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true`, keeping local builds fast.

**3. Use severity configuration instead of TreatWarningsAsErrors:**
```xml
<TreatWarningsAsErrors>false</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
<WarningsAsErrors>CS8600;CS8602;CS8603</WarningsAsErrors> <!-- only nullable warnings -->
```

**4. Skip doc generation in Debug builds:**
```xml
<GenerateDocumentationFile Condition="'$(Configuration)' == 'Release'">true</GenerateDocumentationFile>
```

---

**Expected impact:** For this project size, fixes #1–2 alone should cut Csc time by 60–70%. In a larger solution with many projects, the savings multiply significantly since each project loads all these analyzer assemblies independently.
